steps.what: hand the Calling Stone to the Society Greeter

expect.reply: Why don't you go talk to the Agent in the next room?

steps.source: W0 SELECT, m6-plan.md section 8: cache/m6/0/sel-academy.tsv: academygreeter 30991, Give (category 6) of 5084: Tell, StampQuest CallingStoneGiven; W0 SELECT, m6-plan.md section 8: cache/m6/0/sel-academy-8602.tsv (every object placed in 0x8602): the Society Greeter 30991 in the start cell 0x860201AD at (9.84, -31.73, 0); the Calling Stone is in a new character's pack (ladder note section 7); the same step as the full route's first (quests/academy.json); the greeter's Give emote set also broadcasts 'If you wish to skip this tutorial, go talk to Jonathan in the next room' (type 68), W0 SELECT, m6-plan.md section 8 / D37

steps.what: ask Jonathan for the Exit Token

expect.reply: If you want to skip your training and leave the Academy early

steps.source: W0 SELECT, m6-plan.md section 8 / D37: Jonathan 29324, Use (category 7): InqQuest AcademeyExitTokenGiven (the server's spelling); on failure (the first time) Tell 'If you want to skip your training and leave the Academy early, give this token back to me.', StampQuest AcademeyExitTokenGiven, Give the Exit Token 29335 (tokentrainingexit), Tell 'But beware, once you leave the Training Academy, you cannot come back!'; asked again he says 'I already gave you an Exit Token.' and gives nothing

steps.what: give the Exit Token back to Jonathan: the server teleports the player to Holtburg

expect.reply: Make sure you talk to Alcott

steps.source: W0 SELECT, m6-plan.md section 8 / D37: Jonathan 29324, Give (category 6) of 29335: Give 12711 twice, GotoSet pick_coat_color (one coat of 13210-13219), then finalize_exit: InqQuest RecallsDisabled's set (category 22) gives 49563, teleports the player to Holtburg 0xA9B40019 (84.0, 7.1) (emote type 63, the server's own teleport, not a tool verb), EraseQuest AcademeyExitTokenGiven (31), Tell 'Make sure you talk to Alcott to continue your journey.', AwardLevelProportionalXP (type 62) amount 11,000 (the level reached is reported, never assumed)

done.reply: Make sure you talk to Alcott
